name: manage_template
description:
Manage editor templates for the current project.

Actions:
- get: inspect one template by templateId.
- list_assets: list every asset under a template, grouped by type. Use this before deciding apply vs generation.
- apply: copy the whole template timeline/content into the current project. This is the preferred path when the template structure fits.
- copy_assets: copy all template assets into the current project without placing the full template. Use this only when a new MG must embed or remap template media as project-local asset IDs. The result returns project-local copied asset IDs.

Decision rule: if the template can be used as-is and this is normal template usage, call apply. If a new custom MG should borrow the template, use the current surface's MG creation workflow. Preserve the template structure only for the same visual job, same structure, and same canvas role; otherwise borrow its visual language and create a structure that fits the requested content. Template slot counts are not hard limits: if the user asks for more/fewer bars, rows, cards, or data points than the template shows, create a new structure instead of asking them to fit the slots. Call copy_assets only when the new MG must embed or remap template media as project-local assets, then use the returned copied project-local asset IDs.

omitAssetIds.description: For apply: template asset IDs to omit.

placement.description: For apply: optional placement. targetTrackId can be a full track id or prefix accepted by backend resolution.

projectId.description: Existing project ID from the editor URL or list_projects. Pass this when continuing work on an existing project and the external MCP session is not already targeted.

templateId.description: Template UUID from a <template id=...> block or templateRefs value.
